pests.name: Pests
pests.line: I've got mice, rats or roaches in my home.

sources.passage: Of the 124 million occupied households in the United States: 14.8 million saw signs of mice or rats inside the home in the last 12 months. 14.0 million saw signs of cockroaches inside the home in the last 12 months. Source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, 2019 American Housing Survey.

pests.prevalence: Of 124 million U.S. households in 2019, 14.8 million saw signs of mice or rats inside the home in the last 12 months, and 14.0 million saw signs of cockroaches (American Housing Survey).

damp-and-mold.name: Damp and mold
damp-and-mold.line: My home is damp, and the mold keeps coming back.

sources.passage: Of the 124 million occupied households in the United States: 3.7 million reported mold in the last 12 months. ... 9.4 million reported water leakage from inside the home. Source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, 2019 American Housing Survey.
was 15.60% in December of 2024, according to the EUROSTAT.

damp-and-mold.prevalence: In 2019, 3.7 million of 124 million U.S. households reported mold in the last 12 months and 9.4 million reported water leaking inside the home (American Housing Survey). In 2024, 15.6% of people in the EU lived with a leaking roof, damp or rot (Eurostat).

tap-water.name: Tap water
tap-water.line: I don't trust the water that comes out of my tap.

sources.passage: March 3-16, 2025 ... please tell me if you personally worry about this problem a great deal, a fair amount, only a little, or not at all. ... Pollution of drinking water 54 26 20

tap-water.prevalence: In March 2025, 54% of U.S. adults said they personally worry a great deal about pollution of drinking water (Gallup).

accessible-home.name: Accessible home
accessible-home.line: I have trouble getting into or around my own home.
aliases: My home doesn't fit my body any more

sources.passage: How Well Does the Housing Stock Meet Accessibility Needs? An Analysis of the 2019 American Housing Survey ... About 5 percent of households reported that they experienced difficulty navigating or using their homes, amounting to a total of 6.8 million households.

accessible-home.prevalence: In 2019, about 5 percent of U.S. households, 6.8 million, had difficulty getting around or using their own home (Harvard JCHS analysis of the American Housing Survey).

living-with-parents.name: Living with parents
living-with-parents.line: I want a place of my own, but I still live with my parents.

sources.passage: In 2023, 18% of adults ages 25 to 34 were living in a parent’s home.

living-with-parents.prevalence: In 2023, 18% of U.S. adults ages 25 to 34 lived in a parent's home (Pew Research Center).

landlord-wont-fix.name: Repairs
landlord-wont-fix.line: My landlord won't fix what's broken.

turned-down-for-housing.name: Rental applications
turned-down-for-housing.line: I keep getting turned down for places to rent.
aliases: Can't get approved for an apartment
